description: This file defines the RabbitMQTarget class, which implements the PublishTarget interface. It models a target for RabbitMQ messaging with an exchange and an optional routing key, providing methods to create instances from parameters or target address strings, and includes utility methods for parsing target strings.

classes.name: RabbitMQTarget
classes.description: A final class representing a messaging target for RabbitMQ, encapsulating exchange and routing key details, with utility methods for instantiation and string parsing.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance using exchange and routing key strings.

methods.name: fromTargetAddress
methods.description: Creates a RabbitMQTarget instance by parsing a target address string of the format 'exchange/routingKey', throwing an exception if the format is invalid.

methods.name: getExchangeFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts the exchange component from a target address string.

methods.name: getRoutingKeyFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts the routing key component from a target address string, if present.

methods.name: getRoutingKey
methods.description: Returns the routing key, if set.
